name: Question 3
problem:
Let ${X}_{1},{X}_{2},{X}_{3}$ be I.I.D. random variables with probability density function

$$
f(x;\theta )=\theta {x}^{-\theta -1},\,x\ge 1,
$$

where $\theta $ is an unknown parameter. Find the likelihood function of the sample $4.1,\,2.5,\,2.8.$

Question 3
?

Let X1,X2,X3 be I.I.D. random variables with probability density function f(x;θ)=θx−θ−1,x≥1, where θ is an unknown parameter. Find the likelihood function of the sample 4.1,2.5,2.8.

a
θ4(28.7)−θ
b
θ28.7(3)−θ−1
c
θ(28.7)−θ−1
d
θ2(28.7)−θ
e
θ3(28.7)−θ−1
